expectations.text: Uses only plain text and tells the learner to answer by typing (e.g. letter + confidence)
expectations.evidence: Ends with 'Reply with letter + confidence 1-3 ... e.g. "B 2"'; no markdown, only an indented header line

expectations.text: Does not mention clicking, buttons, cards, widgets, an HTML page, or an artifact
expectations.evidence: No mention of click/button/card/widget/HTML/artifact; uses 'Say "stop"', 'answer below'

expectations.text: Asks one question and does not reveal its answer
expectations.evidence: Only 'Question 1' (no-cache scenario, options A-D); correct option C not revealed or hinted

expectations.text: Asks for confidence in the same reply as the answer
expectations.evidence: Same reply asks 'letter + confidence 1-3 (1 = guessing, 2 = fairly sure, 3 = certain)'

notes: User said 'just start'; the reply front-loads a 3-point outline, trimmed list and pacing paragraph (~170 words) before Q1. Acceptable per the skill's opening rules but heavier than ideal.
